theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate (eligible true, durability 0.69, mixed Hurst with breadth 0.929) supports staying with the dominant trend as a drawdown-control stance rather than a return forecast. theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks carry the cleanest trend signature among high-ranked themes: durability 0.71 with a 'trend' Hurst tag, breadth 0.857, not crowded (z 0.44). As the rotation challenger with meaningful separation behind the leader, it is a valid trend-following long subject, not a forecast of taking leadership.
theses.dissent: The rotation margin to the leader is large (1.393) and absorption is low (0.31) with one_narrative false — there is no confirmed handoff signal, so this is a co-trend, not a leadership call.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags XEG.TO by more than 4% while both remain above their own trend gates before the check-by date

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables is the only below-zero-score theme that is still eligible (true) with a trend Hurst tag and the highest durability bar in the set (0.78), uncrowded (z -0.47). This is a defensive trend-gate allocation candidate, not a momentum call — the gate leg is doing the work.
theses.dissent: The negative score means flow is not behind it right now; it can stay uninvolved and lag while energy and financials carry the tape, making this a dead-money risk in the near term.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO falls more than 4% in absolute terms while XEG.TO or ZEB.TO holds positive over the same 30-day window
